---
title: "Online principal-subspace estimation with adaptive Markov chain Monte Carlo"
subtitle: "A controlled stochastic approximation analysis"
author:
  - name: "Jordan Simbananiye"
    affiliations:
      - name: "University College London — CCMI CDT"
date: last-modified
abstract: |
  We investigate whether Oja's online principal-subspace iteration can be
  coupled to adaptive Markov chain Monte Carlo without assuming independent
  samples.  The adaptive mean and covariance estimates follow the recursion
  considered by Andrieu and Moulines, while an additional Stiefel-valued
  iterate is updated through a polar retraction.  We identify the common
  averaged vector field, establish a uniform second-order bound for the
  retraction error, and give an explicit weighted Poisson decomposition of
  the controlled Markov fluctuations.  A localized convergence theorem
  shows that, on eventually compact parameter trajectories, the estimates
  approach the target moments and the Oja iterate approaches the collection
  of invariant subspaces of the target covariance.  A composite Lyapunov
  function provides a quantitative dissipativity argument on compact sets.
  The remaining global stability question, needed for an unconditional
  convergence theorem for the untruncated algorithm, is isolated explicitly.
keywords:
  - adaptive MCMC
  - online PCA
  - Oja iteration
  - stochastic approximation
  - Poisson equation
  - retraction
---
